propositions: Directory creation and first event file write race in _prepare_event leaves empty ticket directories visible to fsck when the writer is interrupted between makedirs and os.replace

New staging module publishes ticket directory and CREATE event atomically via os.rename under the write lock, making temp paths invisible to fsck via dot-prefix convention already honored by existing scanners
Stale staging directories from dead processes are swept at writer start using lock_owner v2 stamps (host+pid-namespace+start-time), bounded and touching only temp paths never ticket data

All same-signature dir-then-first-file sites in the store write path (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) are converted to use atomic staging or explicitly exempted with reasons
Byte parity and event format are unchanged; canonical serialization still comes from the single shared helper, routed through staging before publish
